title: The Fox and the Grapes
description: The fable behind the phrase "sour grapes", retold in simple English.
description_zh: “酸葡萄”这个说法的来源，用简单英语重述。

units.text: One hot afternoon, a fox was walking through a vineyard.
units.translation: 一个炎热的下午，一只狐狸走过一片葡萄园。

units.text: High above his head, he saw a bunch of ripe, purple grapes.
units.translation: 在头顶高处，他看见一串熟透的紫葡萄。

units.text: "Those look delicious," he said. "Just what I need on a day like this."
units.translation: “看起来真好吃，”他说，“这样的天气正需要这个。”

units.text: He jumped as high as he could, but he missed them.
units.translation: 他使劲往上跳，却没够着。

units.text: He stepped back, ran, and jumped again.
units.translation: 他退后几步，助跑，再跳一次。

units.text: Again and again he tried, and again and again he failed.
units.translation: 他试了一次又一次，也失败了一次又一次。

units.text: At last, tired and hot, he gave up.
units.translation: 最后，他又累又热，放弃了。

units.text: As he walked away, he lifted his nose and said, "They were probably sour anyway."
units.translation: 走开的时候，他扬起鼻子说：“反正那些葡萄大概是酸的。”

units.text: It is easy to hate what you cannot have.
units.translation: 得不到的东西，说它不好总是容易的。
